### Changed
- The kagent controller route is a **`GRPCRoute`** with the **JWT policy on by default** (#345; kagent API v2, giantswarm/giantswarm#37705, bumblebee-plans#51 D4/D13/D16). `kagent.controllerRoute` renders the controller's API through the agentgateway data plane matched by gRPC service and method — one rule per service, one exact match per RPC of `kagent.api.v1alpha1.{AgentInstanceService, AgentTemplateService, ModelService, SystemService}` and `lf.a2a.v1.A2AService`, 39 at the line's pin, as the value `kagent.controllerRoute.grpc.services` (the agentgateway controller translates a service-only match into the exact path `/<service>/`, which no request has, and ignores `type: RegularExpression`, so a service-only route would fall through to the MCP catch-all; exact service/method matches are translated faithfully and outrank the catch-all's `PathPrefix: /` — verified on the data plane's config dump; reported to the agentgateway line) — on both hops: `GRPCRoute kagent-controller` on the data-plane Gateway (hostname-less, so the in-cluster authority `agentgateway.<namespace>.svc.cluster.local:8080` matches) and `GRPCRoute kagent-controller-public` on the public Gateway for `kagent.controllerRoute.hostname`, which makes the outer Gateway carry HTTP/2 to the agentgateway Service; the `AgentgatewayBackend kagent` keeps `policies.auth.passthrough`, so the bearer reaches the controller and, through the Harness, the actor, and pins no protocol version: agentgateway infers HTTP/2 (h2c) for gRPC and keeps HTTP/1.1 for gRPC-Web, the split the controller's one-port dispatcher needs (an HTTP/2 request with `application/grpc-web+proto` goes to its native gRPC server and is answered `415`). Native gRPC over HTTP/2 end to end from the public hostname and from the in-cluster Service; gRPC-Web on the same route. `kagent.controllerRoute.jwtAuthentication.enabled` defaults to `true`, `Strict`, the issuer from `global.identity.issuerUrl`, the JWKS from `jwtAuthentication.jwks` (new `jwks.tls.{enabled,caSecretName}` for an issuer serving its keys over TLS, as `modelManager.route` has); the `AgentgatewayPolicy kagent-controller-jwt` targets the GRPCRoute and now also carries the **identity transformation** — `x-user-id` is `set` to `jwt.<claim>` with the claim from `kagent.controller.auth.userIdClaim` (`email`, the ONE value the controller's `AUTH_USER_ID_CLAIM` reads too), replacing every inbound value — and an `authorization` rule that refuses a validated token without that claim (it would otherwise reach the controller as its default user). The kagent UI `HTTPRoute` gains a `RequestHeaderModifier` filter removing `x-user-id` (the UI's nginx forwards it; the identity on that path is the bearer oauth2-proxy supplies). The controller's network policy admits the agentgateway data-plane pods and the kagent UI only, in both flavours (the kubernetes flavour admitted the whole release namespace; the intra-namespace `app: kagent` admission is gone with the per-agent pods). A `BackendTrafficPolicy kagent-controller-public` on the public hop carries `ingress.backendTrafficPolicy.timeout` (a `GRPCRoute` rule has no `timeouts`; Envoy's default would cut every A2A streaming turn). The Dev Portal's app-config `agentPlatform.kagent.installations.<inst>.apiBaseUrl` is the gRPC origin `https://<hostname>` (no path); the meta chart's `klausGateway.a2a.url` defaults to `grpc://agentgateway.agent-platform.svc.cluster.local:8080`. docs/authentication.md gains "The kagent controller route — two authentication layers" (the header contract, why agentgateway must stay the only path). `make verify-kagent-route` asserts all of it; `ci/test-kagent-jwt-policy-values.yaml` is the default shape and `ci/test-kagent-jwt-off-values.yaml` the off switch. **An installation with the controller route on needs `gateway.jwksEgress` open (the render fails otherwise) and its clients on gRPC** — see UPGRADE.md.
### Removed
- The REST `HTTPRoute` on `kagent.controllerRoute.pathPrefix` (`/kagent`) and the `pathPrefix` key (#345): the kagent API v2 controller serves no REST and the route is a `GRPCRoute` matched by service, so there is no prefix to strip; a `pathPrefix` left in an installation's values fails the render naming the key. With it goes the portal's `<hostname>/kagent/api` REST base and klaus-gateway's `…/kagent/api/a2a/kagent` A2A base — both are gRPC targets now (above).
